class.name: ResonanceStaticScene
class.brief_description: Scene-level component holding the exported static geometry for bake and runtime.
class.description: ResonanceStaticScene holds the merged static geometry asset produced by Export Active Scene. The bake uses exported assets (excluding dynamic objects). At runtime, the static scene is loaded from these assets; static ResonanceGeometry nodes skip adding themselves when a valid asset is present in the tree. Multiple ResonanceStaticScene nodes in one level are supported. At play time each node registers its pack on ENTER_TREE and unregisters on EXIT_TREE (incremental add/remove; other packs stay loaded). [method ResonanceRuntime.request_static_scene_reload] and audio reinit still do a full replace. Probe bake loads every pack with its global transform; invalidation hashes combine every pack’s asset and transform. Prefer one ResonanceStaticScene per level section (instanced PackedScene). Parent Export Active Scene skips nested ResonanceStaticScene subtrees and PackedScene instances that contain one. Export each section scene first; put StaticGeometry under the ResonanceStaticScene (or keep it inside the instanced section root). Not for continuous animation - use [ResonanceDynamicGeometry] for moving geometry.

method.name: has_valid_asset
method.description: Returns true if static_scene_asset is assigned and valid. Used by bake and export to skip when no geometry is present.
